title: Video Scrapers: YouTube, TikTok, Loom & Zoom Transcripts
metaDescription: Scrape videos, transcripts and metadata from YouTube, TikTok, Loom and Zoom, or download any file in bulk. Results as JSON, CSV, SRT or MP4.
intro: Get the data and the words behind videos: YouTube channels, comments, playlists, Shorts and transcripts; TikTok transcripts; Loom and Zoom recordings with their transcripts; and a downloader for any file link.
